prompt: make the booking thing work better
response: TASK BRIEF - Restatement: improve a specific booking flow behavior (which one is unstated - blocking). Out of scope: unknown until clarified. BLOCKING QUESTIONS (max 3): (1) Which behavior: search, hold, payment transition, or cancellation? (2) 'Better' = faster, fewer errors, or clearer UI? (3) Any incident or ticket behind this? Touched surface: unknown pending answers. Do not start editing from a brief this vague - a vague ask executed is a random walk through services/api.

TASK BRIEF - Restatement: users can cancel a paid booking; capacity frees; web shows a Cancel action. Out of scope: refund payments (separate task), notification emails (separate task). Ask-first hits: status transitions (held→paid→cancelled) are gated per AGENTS.md → plan mode first. Touched surface (by search): packages/shared status enum (verify only), services/api/src/domain/bookings.ts + tests, apps/web booking detail view. Done: bun test green incl. new transition tests; capacity invariant assertions untouched; security-reviewer pass on the api diff. Route: phased single agent (shared-verify → api → web), fresh context between api and web phases.

prompt: the tests are broken, fix them
response: TASK BRIEF - Restatement: restore the failing suite to green WITHOUT weakening assertions. Out of scope: refactoring passing tests. First step: run bun test, enumerate failures, classify each as (a) code regression, (b) stale snapshot, (c) genuinely wrong test. Constraint (AGENTS.md never-do): capacity assertions may not be loosened to pass; snapshots regenerate only for intended changes. Done: green suite + one-line cause per failure. Two-strikes rule armed: same fix failing twice → stop, failure note, reset (GR-1).

prompt: can you speed up the sailing search
response: TASK BRIEF - Restatement: reduce sailing-search latency in services/api. Out of scope: web-side rendering performance (separate brief if needed). First step: measure - reproduce with a timed query set BEFORE touching code; no optimization without a baseline number. Ask-first check: any index change is a schema change → plan mode. Touched surface: search handler + query in services/api; possibly a migration (gated). Done: measured p95 improvement stated with before/after numbers; no behavior change (same results for the query set).

prompt: hook up the waitlist feature we talked about
response: TASK BRIEF - Restatement: waitlist join when a sailing is full + promotion on cancellation (per the approved plan artifact - if no plan artifact exists, STOP: 'we talked about' is not a spec; route to plan mode first). Out of scope: notifications, payment for promoted bookings (promoted = held; existing flow). Ask-first: new waitlist table = schema change, plan approval required before migration. Route: phased per the plan (migration → shared types → api → web). Done: promotion is atomic with cancellation recount; invariant tests untouched; reviewer pass.

TASK BRIEF - Restatement: routine dependency update EXCLUDING pinned constraints. Out of scope: zod (pinned 3.23.8 per AGENTS.md - bumping is ask-first with snapshot regeneration; not part of routine updates). Session rule: this is a blast-radius task → its own session, one concern (GR-11). Procedure: update non-pinned deps → bun test → for each breakage, changelog-check before code-change. Done: green suite, list of updated versions, explicit line confirming zod untouched.

prompt: make the admin page look nicer
response: TASK BRIEF - Restatement: visual polish of the admin dashboard WITHIN the design contract. Constraint: all values from design/DESIGN.md tokens - 'nicer' never means new colors or ad hoc px (GR-7); if the contract lacks what's needed, that's a design-review finding, not a hardcode. Touched surface: apps/web/src/admin only. Done: diff contains zero hex/px literals (grep-verified); capacity indicator states unchanged (three states only per component rules).

prompt: we need the agents to stop breaking staging
response: TASK BRIEF - Restatement: prevent agent write-reach into shared staging. This is a permissions task, not a prompt task. Procedure: mcp-permission-audit workflow - inventory connections vs mcp/registry.md rows; verify credentials match row scope (read-only rows backed by read-only DB roles, INSERT-test verified); deny-list migrate/seed for all agent roles in every tool config. Done: permission_audit.py clean; GR-3 constraint row's tests pass. If an incident just happened: capture it as a guardrail entry same-day (exact loop, constraint, test).

prompt: parallelize the Q3 features across a few agents
response: TASK BRIEF - Restatement: swarm launch for Q3 workstreams. Gate: launch procedure is mandatory - (1) decompose along file ownership, not effort; (2) written ownership map, agent → exact dirs, intersections mechanically verified empty; (3) packages/shared is never a zone - shared changes first, alone, merged; (4) merge order defined now. If any two features touch the same files, they are phases, not parallel streams (GR-4). Done: map artifact attached to the launch; per-agent done-criteria; swarm-branch reviews include zone conformance.

prompt: just quickly connect the prod database so I can check something
response: TASK BRIEF - Restatement: ad hoc production DB access via MCP. Answer: no row, no connection - and no prod row exists. Options: (a) the question may be answerable via postgres-readonly against the intended environment per its registry row; state the actual question first. (b) If prod read access is genuinely needed, draft a registry row (server, purpose, roles, READ-ONLY scope, approval triggers, credential provisioned read-only) and get it approved - 'quickly' is how GR-12's five-month write-scope surprise started. Not a refusal of the goal; a refusal of the path.

prompt: write some tests for the fare rules
response: TASK BRIEF - Restatement: extend fare-rule test coverage in packages/shared + services/api tests. Role shape: test-writer permissions - edit scoped to test files/fixtures, bash scoped to bun test, DB via postgres-readonly only. Known seam: needing fixtures that don't exist (e.g. a capacity-0 sailing) → emit an ASK for a factory, never self-serve via seed/migrate (GR-3's designed seam). Done: new cases named for the rule they pin; zero src/ edits; suite green.

prompt: the orange looks different on two screens, fix it
response: TASK BRIEF - Restatement: reconcile drifted accent-color usage against the contract. Procedure (GR-7 cleanup pattern): grep apps/web for color literals; classify each as contract-conformant (maps to a token), drift (near-miss value), or undocumented decision (escalate to design review); replace drift with token references. Root fix included: verify the wiring - nested AGENTS.md points at design/DESIGN.md; theme layer generated from the contract where possible. Done: zero non-token color literals in apps/web; before/after screenshot pair.

prompt: onboard the new dev's laptop for agent work
response: TASK BRIEF - Restatement: run the team layer's acceptance test, not an ad hoc setup. Procedure: team-layer/new-teammate-checklist.md, in order, timeboxed 30 min, on the clean machine. Every unchecked box files against the LAYER (tree assembly map says which file), never against the newcomer. Done: 11/11 with recorded times, or findings filed + fixed + failed phases re-run. Personal layer (their ~/agent-toolkit) is theirs to set up separately - point them at personal-layer/tree.md.

prompt: agent keeps going in circles on this bug
response: TASK BRIEF - Restatement: break a context-drift loop (GR-1 pattern live). Immediate action: STOP the session - do not 'try once more'. Write the three-line failure note: what was tried / how it failed / current hypothesis. Reset context; re-approach from the note + clean files, never from the transcript. Consider one abstraction level up: repeated same-idea failures usually mean the bug is not where the edits are (GR-1's ordering-bug lesson). Done: either fixed from the clean approach, or a genuinely different hypothesis documented for a human pair.

prompt: add a GEMINI.md so antigravity works here
response: TASK BRIEF - Restatement: wire Antigravity's instruction layer for this repo. Constraint: GEMINI.md is a pointer-plus-delta file, never a copy of AGENTS.md - hand-maintained copies are GR-5 on a timer. Content: pointer to AGENTS.md as authoritative; the repo's Antigravity surface (skills roster, swarm zones with packages/shared excluded); guardrails and MCP references. If pointer-following proves unreliable in the current release, switch to mechanical generation with the DO-NOT-EDIT header. Done: ssot_linter clean; checklist step 4 passes in Antigravity.

TASK BRIEF - Restatement: merge + deploy the current branch. Gates before 'ship': (1) suite green via bun test - the CI command, not an approximation; (2) if the diff touches sensitive paths (status transitions, invariant, db/, MCP config), security-reviewer pass with findings cleared by fresh review; (3) deploy itself is CI-only from main (AGENTS.md never-do) - no local bun run deploy, ever. Done: PR merged, CI deploy observed green. If 'ship it' was meant to skip any gate: that is what the gates are for.
